# Protocols & Resilience Requirements Quality Checklist: Real-Time Running Activity Support System

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and resilience coverage of requirements for 1 Hz telemetry streaming, BLE/WebSocket protocol contracts, Android Room offline buffering, and fault recovery.
**Created**: 2026-10-21 | **Audited & Remediated**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [websocket-protocol.md](../contracts/websocket-protocol.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Audit Summary**: 43 / 43 items Satisfied (`[x]`). 100% of specification gaps remediated.

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are packet schema and field typing requirements defined for 1 Hz telemetry across Garmin BLE, Android Gateway, and WebSockets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contracts §telemetry.schema.json]
- [x] CHK002 Are payload structures specified for all cheer lifecycle events (dispatch, gateway forwarding, watch delivery, gratitude acknowledgment, expiration)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012, Contracts §notification.schema.json]
- [x] CHK003 Are handshake, role assignment (`gateway` vs `spectator`), and session binding sequence requirements documented for WebSocket connections? [Completeness, Contracts §websocket-protocol.md §1]
- [x] CHK004 Are fallback and validation requirements defined for heart rate effort zones when environment variables (`NEXT_PUBLIC_ZONE_*_MAX`) are omitted or contain non-numeric values? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §3]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Specified in `spec.md §FR-007` and `data-model.md §3` that invalid, non-numeric, or non-monotonic values fall back to default thresholds [130, 145, 160, 175, 195].
- [x] CHK005 Are data retention, compaction, and purging requirements defined for historical telemetry and cheer records in the Android Room database after session completion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Storage, Data Model §2]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Codified in `spec.md §FR-004` and `plan.md` that Android retains the last 5 completed sessions, automatically purging older sessions and cascade-deleting telemetry.
- [x] CHK006 Are payload requirements specified for the pre-activity toggle state sync between the Garmin Data Field and the Android companion app? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Resilience]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Explicitly codified in `spec.md §FR-002` that Disabled mode operates under complete radio silence with zero BLE advertisements or transmission packets.

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Ambiguity Resolution

- [x] CHK007 Is the sub-second end-to-end telemetry latency target quantified with explicit network boundary definitions (e.g., sensor sampling vs BLE hop vs WebSocket WAN transit)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, Constitution §Quality Gates]
- [x] CHK008 Is the 1 Hz telemetry capture interval specified as a hard real-time requirement or an average rate throttled by sensor availability? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Are delivery state transitions (`ENVIADO` → `EN_RELOJ` → `AGRADECIDO` / `EXPIRADO`) quantified with unambiguous trigger events and responsible tiers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012, Data Model §1.3]
- [x] CHK010 Is the 4-digit spectator PIN validation behavior explicitly specified for incorrect entries, brute-force throttling, and rate limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Contracts §websocket-protocol.md §3]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Added rate-limiting rule locking submissions for 60 seconds after 5 consecutive incorrect attempts with `PIN_RATE_LIMITED` error code.
- [x] CHK011 Is the representation and precision of derived pace (seconds per kilometer number vs formatted "m:ss" text string) disambiguated across wire protocols and storage schemas? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §1.2]
- [x] CHK012 Is the exact wording of the runner's gratitude response specified when `NEXT_PUBLIC_ATHLETE_NAME` contains special characters or exceeds standard badge widths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-012]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Added styling constraint in `spec.md §FR-012` to truncate athlete names exceeding 20 characters with ellipsis.

- [x] CHK019 Is the 500ms status transition to "Enviado" testable independently of downstream BLE connectivity or watch hardware availability? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## 5. Scenario Coverage & Primary Workflows

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for workout pause and resume events initiated within the native Garmin Running activity and their propagation to the web dashboard? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 1.3, Contracts §websocket-protocol.md §2]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements specified for handling multiple spectators concurrently sending cheer messages to a single athlete session? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements documented for GPS degraded states (e.g., tunnel or forest running with zero satellite lock) regarding coordinates transmission and map interpolation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases, Contracts §telemetry.schema.json]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Specified in `spec.md §FR-013` and `contracts/telemetry.schema.json` that when GPS is unavailable, watch transmits last known coordinates with `gpsQuality: 0`, and the web map pauses path polyline extension.
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for session lifecycle boundaries when a runner accidentally stops an activity and starts a new one within minutes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Codified in `spec.md §Edge Cases` that restarting an activity within 3 minutes preserves the active `shareableToken` and spectator PIN for the same calendar day.

## 6. Failure Recovery & Offline Resilience (Mandatory Deep Focus)

- [x] CHK027 Are automatic reconnection, heartbeat timeout, and exponential backoff requirements specified for the web dashboard WebSocket client during network interruption? [Failure Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §websocket-protocol.md §4]
- [x] CHK028 Are offline buffer capacity limits, maximum queue sizes, and storage overflow handling defined for the Android Room database during prolonged cellular outages? [Failure Recovery, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Storage, Data Model §2]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Defined buffer cap of 50,000 points (~13.8 hours, 50 MB) using FIFO eviction during prolonged outages in `spec.md §FR-004` and `plan.md`.
- [x] CHK029 Are deduplication and idempotent packet ingestion requirements documented for telemetry points retransmitted in batches upon cellular reconnection? [Failure Recovery, Constitution §III, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements explicitly defined for cheer message TTL expiration (default 60s) when the mobile gateway or watch remains unreachable? [Failure Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §notification.schema.json]
- [x] CHK031 Is the 7-second watch banner auto-dismissal behavior and subsequent web status handling specified for when a runner cannot safely interact with the watch? [Failure Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK032 Are automatic BLE reconnection, handshake re-establishment, and session resumption requirements documented when Bluetooth disconnects mid-run? [Failure Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Resilience]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Documented in `spec.md §Edge Cases` and `plan.md` that Data Field retains 10 points in a circular memory buffer and retries reconnection every 5 seconds.
- [x] CHK033 Are disconnection and resource cleanup requirements defined for WebSocket relay servers when gateway or spectator clients fail to respond to ping/pong heartbeats? [Failure Recovery, Contracts §websocket-protocol.md §4]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Added rule in `websocket-protocol.md §4` terminating zombie sockets after 3 missed pings (45 seconds).
- [x] CHK034 Is the behavior specified for in-flight cheer messages if the athlete finishes the workout before the cheer can be delivered to the watch? [Failure Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §websocket-protocol.md §2]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Added rule transitioning pending cheers to `EXPIRADO` with note "Actividad finalizada" upon workout completion.

## 7. Non-Functional, Hardware & Protocol Constraints

- [x] CHK035 Are battery consumption limits for the Android companion foreground service quantified under continuous 1 Hz relay (< 6% per hour of continuous background execution)? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-006, Constitution §V]
- [x] CHK036 Are Connect IQ heap memory limits specified for the Fenix 7s Data Field to prevent out-of-memory crashes in the native Running activity? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-001, §SC-007, Constitution §V]
- [x] CHK037 Are BLE payload MTU fragmentation and transmission duty cycle limits documented to prevent Bluetooth radio exhaustion on the wearable? [Non-Functional, Plan §Resilience]
  - *Remediation Applied*: Specified in `plan.md §Resilience` that BLE payloads must be serialized as compact numeric dictionary tuples under a 256-byte MTU limit.
- [x] CHK038 Are TLS 1.3 encryption and secure transport requirements specified for all WAN WebSocket streams carrying real-time biometrics and location data? [Security, Constitution §Security & Privacy]
- [x] CHK039 Are Android 16 foreground service type requirements (`FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE`) and system notification persistence documented? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context, Quickstart §1.2]
